caption: The drawing consists of a horizontal band bordered at the bottom by straight parallel lines in black, brown, and beige. Above this base, a repeating ornamental pattern occupies the upper half of the image. The central motif features a series of symmetrical, undulating, and scalloped forms rendered in shades of brown and black, interspersed with parallel vertical white lines inside each curve. Light blue and white wavy outlines highlight the contours of these forms, creating a layered effect. Within some of the brown shapes, particularly toward the central peaks of the pattern, there are diamond grids filled with small white dots. The background of the drawing is beige, and the entire image has a clean, stylized appearance with no discernible figurative objects.
title: Wall Paper Border
